mages_legacy.lore.intro.title: The Mage's Legacy
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.lore.1: The mage gave them to the earth. Mycelium grew through their bones and became a second blood.
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.lore.2: The Mycelids don't bury their dead, they plant them. A year later a grove of glowing mushrooms rises there, and in its quiet you can hear the voices of the ancestors.
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.lore.3: They say that somewhere under the roots of the world the mycelium still remembers the mage's voice and retells it to the Mycelids in their dreams.
mages_legacy.race.shepherd.tagline: Bonded beasts and echoes of the fallen
mages_legacy.race.shepherd.lore.1: The mage gave them a voice that beasts and the echoes of the departed answer.
mages_legacy.race.shepherd.lore.2: Shepherds build no houses: home is wherever the pack sleeps. They call every beast by name and remember every fallen one, and that is why the fallen answer.
mages_legacy.race.frozen.lore.1: Disciples of the nameless mage who stood beside him as he split people into races.
mages_legacy.race.frozen.lore.2: A splinter of that moment struck them, and time has run through them unevenly ever since. The Frozen rarely laugh: they have already lived every joy of theirs once.
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.lore.1: They offered the mage their blood in exchange for a long life. He took it and never gave it back.
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.lore.2: Since then their own blood leaks away like water from a cracked cup. The Bloodkin live by night, swear on blood and never drink from the same cup twice.
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.tagline: The void and a pocket of their own
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.lore.1: The mage led them through the first obelisk. They did not all come back: part of each of them is still there, in the void.
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.lore.2: To them the world is thin as paper. The Voidborn speak in whispers, because they hear something beyond the walls of the world answer them.
mages_legacy.race.mercenary.tagline: Work, pay and the Mage's Shop
mages_legacy.race.mercenary.lore.1: They served the nameless mage for pay: carried his staves, guarded the obelisks, killed whoever he pointed at. When the mage split humankind he paid them too, but in his own way.
mages_legacy.race.mercenary.lore.2: Mercenaries don't believe in gifts: whatever is given for free will one day be asked back. They keep their word while they're paid, and keep count of every debt, theirs and others'.
mages_legacy.race.tempter.tagline: A kiss, wings and other hearts
mages_legacy.race.tempter.lore.1: The nameless mage was endlessly lonely. When he split humankind, some were given his longing: the wish to be looked at, to be wanted.
mages_legacy.race.tempter.lore.2: Tempters are loved at first sight and can't be forgotten until the last breath. They say their kiss is remembered longer than one's own name.
mages_legacy.race.masked.lore.1: The mage gave them no face of their own. Instead he gave them the knack of taking others'.
mages_legacy.race.masked.lore.2: Beneath the mask there is nothing: no face, no name. The Masked know one another not by voice or eyes, but by whose faces they choose.
mages_legacy.race.masked.lore.3: Every face rots in time, and the Masked becomes no one again. So they are always hunting.
mages_legacy.lore.page.1: Once all people were one folk: weak, mortal and all alike.
mages_legacy.lore.page.2: Then came a mage whose name was forgotten before the first cities were built. He raised the first obelisk and through its eye saw what each of us could become.
mages_legacy.lore.page.4: So one folk became eight. The mage left, and no one saw where. But his gift did not vanish: it sleeps in the blood of everyone born into this world.
mages_legacy.lore.page.5: Today it wakes in you. Choose whose legacy you will carry. The choice is made once.
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.gift: Some he gave to the earth
mages_legacy.race.shepherd.gift: To others, a voice for beasts and the fallen
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.gift: Some he bade pay in blood
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.gift: Some he led through the void
mages_legacy.race.mercenary.gift: His hirelings he paid in power
mages_legacy.race.tempter.gift: To some he gave his longing
mages_legacy.race.shepherd.lore.3: The old ones say their first horn belonged to the mage himself: he blew it to call the people to the obelisk.
mages_legacy.race.frozen.lore.3: They count days not by the sun but by sand, and in each of their houses stands a clock no one has ever wound.
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.lore.3: They say the mage still carries a vial of their blood at his belt. While it is full, no Bloodkin dies their own death.
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.lore.3: Each carries a splinter of that void, and sooner or later finds a home in it.
mages_legacy.race.mercenary.lore.3: There is still a light in the Mage's Shop. Who stands behind its counter no one knows, and the mercenaries say it's better not to ask.
mages_legacy.race.tempter.lore.3: Alone, they are cold. So they go where they will be seen, even if that is a battlefield.
mages_legacy.screen.asleep_desc: The strengths and weaknesses of this people have not awakened yet. The mage will return them in time.
mages_legacy.screen.ability_meta: Opens at level %s · key %s · %s Void · every %s s
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.perk.1: Void: the race's resource, gathers by itself; faster in the dark, twice as fast in the End and the Pocket
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.perk.2: The Pocket: a dimension of your own, a 5×5 island in the starry void; whatever you build and store there stays
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.perk.4: You can sleep in the Pocket, and that sleep skips the night in the world too
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.weak.1: Water burns, as it burns endermen
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.weak.3: The world's beds don't hold them: they can only sleep in the Pocket
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.weak.4: While walking through the void you can't strike or use items
mages_legacy.ability.pocket.name: Pocket
mages_legacy.ability.pocket.lore: A home that is always one step away.
mages_legacy.ability.pocket.desc: Opens a rift into your Pocket, an island in the starry void. Players standing right by you (3×3) come along. Press again in the Pocket to bring everyone back where you left from. You can only build on the island itself. Can't be entered for 5 seconds after taking damage. Leaving is free.
mages_legacy.ability.void_step.name: Void Step
mages_legacy.ability.void_step.lore: A wall is only the thought of a wall.
mages_legacy.ability.void_step.desc: You go into the void between worlds and in about 1.25 seconds fly through it up to 12 blocks where you look; your look isn't turned. Look at a wall or a ceiling and you come out in the first free space behind it, at your own height. Look at the ground or a slope and you come out on its surface (climbing up to 8 blocks). Never in stone or lava; bedrock bars the way. In the void you can't be seen or hurt, but you can't strike or use items either.
mages_legacy.ability.gravity.name: Heavier Gravity
mages_legacy.ability.gravity.lore: The void pulls everything near towards itself. Sometimes too hard.
mages_legacy.ability.gravity.desc: V: for 4 seconds a field of weight with a radius of 7 blocks surrounds you, its edge drawn on the ground. Once a second, with a heavy beat, every enemy in it takes 1 damage, is driven into the ground and slowed (Slowness I). Fliers and jumpers are dragged down. 25 Void, 18-second cooldown.
mages_legacy.message.became: You are now: %s. The legacy has awakened.
mages_legacy.refuse.busy: You are already on your way
mages_legacy.refuse.no_pocket: The Pocket is not available on this server
mages_legacy.refuse.pocket_hurt: Space still trembles from the blow: the Pocket won't open
mages_legacy.refuse.pocket_edge: Past the Pocket's edge there is only void
mages_legacy.refuse.bed: The world's beds don't hold you. Sleep in your Pocket
mages_legacy.screen.tree_hint: Drag to move, scroll to zoom, click a glowing node to learn it
mages_legacy.talent.state.automatic: Opens by itself at race level %s
mages_legacy.talent.pocket.name: Pocket
mages_legacy.talent.pocket.desc: The Voidborn's core: a dimension of your own. The whole tree grows from here.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket.lore: A home that is always one step away.
mages_legacy.talent.void_step.name: Void Step
mages_legacy.talent.void_step.desc: The basic ability of Through Worlds (key R).
mages_legacy.talent.void_step.lore: A wall is only the thought of a wall.
mages_legacy.talent.gravity.name: Heavier Gravity
mages_legacy.talent.gravity.desc: The basic ability of Gravity (key V).
mages_legacy.talent.gravity.lore: The void pulls everything near towards itself.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_wide_1.name: Room I
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_wide_1.desc: Your Pocket's island grows to 9×9. Everything built stays where it is.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_wide_1.lore: The void gives way to those who live in it.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_wide_2.name: Room II
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_wide_3.name: Room III
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_wide_3.lore: A small world nobody can take away.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_cheap.name: Light Door
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_cheap.desc: Entering the Pocket costs 10 Void instead of 20 and recovers in 5 seconds instead of 10.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_guests.name: Hospitality
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_guests.desc: Players in the 5×5 around you go into the Pocket with you, not just the 3×3.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_vault.name: High Vaults
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_vault.desc: You can build twice as high and as deep in the Pocket: from 60 blocks below the island to 128 above it.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_cradle.name: The Void's Cradle
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_cradle.desc: A night slept in the Pocket fills your Void to the brim.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_cradle.lore: The void rocks its children to sleep.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_rift.name: Awakening: Rift of Space
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_rift.desc: After a second the rift carries every enemy, pet and player within 25 blocks onto an indestructible 50×50 arena in the void for 60 seconds. Bosses stay in the world. Press again to end it early; the living and the loot go back to safe spots. The owner's death or leaving ends it too. 60 Void, 5 minute cooldown after the arena ends.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_rift.lore: The world is too small for this fight. So you need another.
mages_legacy.talent.arena_regen.name: Quiet Arena
mages_legacy.talent.arena_regen.desc: Allies in the arena get Regeneration I.
mages_legacy.talent.arena_might.name: Arena's Fury
mages_legacy.talent.arena_might.desc: Allies in the arena get Strength I.
mages_legacy.talent.arena_ward.name: Arena Walls
mages_legacy.talent.arena_ward.desc: Allies in the arena get Resistance I.
mages_legacy.talent.arena_long.name: Long Rift
mages_legacy.talent.arena_long.desc: The arena holds for 90 seconds instead of 60.
mages_legacy.talent.step_far.name: Far Step
mages_legacy.talent.step_far.desc: The Void Step reaches 16 blocks instead of 12.
mages_legacy.talent.step_far_2.name: Through Mountains
mages_legacy.talent.step_far_2.lore: Mountains are only a thought too.
mages_legacy.talent.step_quick.name: Short Way
mages_legacy.talent.step_quick.desc: The Void Step recovers in 4 seconds instead of 6.
mages_legacy.talent.step_trace.name: Without a Trace
mages_legacy.talent.step_trace.desc: After a step, creatures within 16 blocks that were hunting you lose track of you, and for 2 seconds nothing farther than 4 blocks can notice you. Bosses aren't fooled.
mages_legacy.talent.step_ally.name: Fellow Traveller
mages_legacy.talent.step_ally.desc: Players within 2 blocks walk through the void with you, each to their own place beside you.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_worlds.des: The Awakening key shows everyone on the server. Choose one: two joined rifts open, before you and before them, for 15 seconds; players and their pets go through both ways. Distance and world don't matter. 40 Void a passage; a charge recovers in 2 minutes. Talents give a second and a third charge, each recovering on its own.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_worlds.lor: Every soul leaves a ripple in space. The Voidborn hears it across any distance, and knows where to step.
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_long.name: Steady Passage
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_long.desc: The passage's rifts stay 30 seconds instead of 15.
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_train.name: Caravan
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_train.desc: Any animal, and mounts with their riders, go through the passage too (your own pets always do).
mages_legacy.talent.grav_wide.name: Wide Weight
mages_legacy.talent.grav_wide.desc: The field of weight's radius is 50% larger (7 → 10.5 blocks).
mages_legacy.talent.grav_slow.name: Leaden Weight
mages_legacy.talent.grav_slow.desc: Heavier Gravity slows harder: Slowness II.
mages_legacy.talent.grav_pull.name: Attraction
mages_legacy.talent.grav_pull.desc: Every pulse of gravity pulls enemies towards you.
mages_legacy.talent.grav_fliers.name: Earthbound
mages_legacy.talent.grav_fliers.desc: Flying enemies in the field are dragged down to the ground. Bosses resist.
mages_legacy.talent.grav_fliers.lore: Wings are only a thought too.
mages_legacy.talent.grav_arrows.name: Bent Paths
mages_legacy.talent.grav_arrows.desc: Enemy projectiles entering the field lose their speed and fall.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_hole.name: Awakening: Black Hole
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_hole.desc: You vanish and become the heart of a singularity (the view steps outside meanwhile): 1.5 s it is born, 3 s it pulls enemies within 20 blocks, then the collapse: 12 damage to enemies within 6 blocks and 4 to you (never below 1 health). All the while you can't move or strike, but can be hurt; allies aren't pulled; bosses barely move; no blocks break. 50 Void, 5-minute cooldown.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_hole.lore: The void inside you is hungry. One day you will feed it.
mages_legacy.talent.hole_wide.name: Event Horizon
mages_legacy.talent.hole_wide.desc: The Black Hole's pull reaches 25% farther (20 → 25 blocks).
mages_legacy.talent.hole_deep.name: Deep Collapse
mages_legacy.talent.hole_deep.desc: The collapse deals 16 damage instead of 12.
mages_legacy.talent.hole_quick.name: Quick Singularity
mages_legacy.talent.hole_quick.desc: The Black Hole gathers in 1 second instead of 1.5.
mages_legacy.talent.step_door.name: Open Door
mages_legacy.talent.step_door.desc: Pocket + Through Worlds. After a Void Step your rift stays open for 3 seconds: an ally who steps into it comes out of your second rift.
mages_legacy.talent.step_heavy.name: Heavy Exit
mages_legacy.talent.step_heavy.desc: Through Worlds + Gravity. Where you come out of the void, a weak field of gravity forms: enemies within 2.5 blocks are slowed for 2 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.door_recoil.name: The Door's Recoil
mages_legacy.talent.door_recoil.desc: Rift of Space + Gravity. When you come back from the Pocket, enemies within 4 blocks of where you appear are slowed (Slowness II, 3 seconds).
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_rift.trial: Trial: grow the Pocket to 15×15 (Space II: %3$s) and sleep %2$s nights in it (so far: %1$s). Opens from race level 30.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_worlds.tri: Trial: Void Step %2$s times through stone rather than air (so far: %1$s), %4$s of them in the Nether (so far: %3$s). Opens from race level 30.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_hole.trial: Trial: %2$s enemies must die under Heavier Gravity (so far: %1$s), %4$s of them fliers (so far: %3$s). Opens from race level 30.
mages_legacy.refuse.singularity: The singularity holds you in place
mages_legacy.refuse.arena_here: Not here: space is already torn
mages_legacy.refuse.no_point: Remember a place first: Shift + the Awakening's key
mages_legacy.refuse.point_other_world: The remembered place is in another world
mages_legacy.refuse.point_far: The remembered place is too far
mages_legacy.message.trial_start: The Void's Trial: five waves, four minutes. Falling won't kill you; it fails the trial.
mages_legacy.message.trial_passed: Trial passed! The second Awakening waits in the talent tree.
mages_legacy.message.trial_failed: Trial failed. You can try again.
mages_legacy.talent.state.superlate_leve: The second Awakening opens from race level %s
mages_legacy.talent.state.superlate_tria: Click to take the race's trial: it opens the second Awakening
mages_legacy.talent.state.third_closed: The third Awakening stays closed: two of three can be opened
mages_legacy.talent.two_of_three: The first Awakening sits on Z, the second (superlate, through the race's trial) on left Alt. Each has its own cost and cooldown.
death.attack.mages_legacy.void_collapse: %1$s was lost in a collapsing void
mages_legacy.traits.title: Traits
mages_legacy.traits.none: No talents yet: learn the first one in the tree.
mages_legacy.guide.title: How the Legacy Grows
mages_legacy.scroll.lore: Give back to the mage what he taught your blood.
mages_legacy.scroll.desc: Right-click: forget every talent except the Awakenings and get their points back. Race and level stay.
mages_legacy.scroll.nothing: Nothing to forget: no talents learned yet
mages_legacy.scroll.done: Your legacy is forgotten: %s talent points came back.
mages_legacy.guide.points.1: Every race level gives 1 point, every tenth 2 more: 60 points by level 50.
mages_legacy.guide.points.2: The whole tree costs far more: choose your path. Cost grows with the tier: 1, 2, 3 points, an Awakening 5.
mages_legacy.guide.points.3: Experience for the same deed is capped every 10 minutes: a race grows by fighting and playing, not by farming.
mages_legacy.guide.points.4: The Scroll of Oblivion gives back every point except the Awakenings', to choose anew (paper, 2 eyes of ender, 2 lapis blocks, 4 amethyst shards).
mages_legacy.guide.awakening.1: The first Awakening opens at tier IV (level 30) after its own trial and sits on Z.
mages_legacy.guide.awakening.2: The second comes in the superlate: from level 45, after the Void's Trial (click the second Awakening's node). It sits on left Alt.
mages_legacy.guide.awakening.3: Two of three can be opened. Each has its own cost and cooldown; they can be used together.
mages_legacy.xp.voidborn.1: Walk through an obstacle with the Void Step
mages_legacy.xp.voidborn.2: Catch an enemy in Heavier Gravity
mages_legacy.xp.voidborn.5: Kill a monster in the dark, the End or the Pocket
mages_legacy.xp.voidborn.6: Sleep a night in the Pocket
mages_legacy.talent.state.tier_2: Tier II opens at race level 10
mages_legacy.talent.state.tier_3: Tier III opens at race level 20
mages_legacy.talent.state.tier_4: Tier IV opens at race level 30
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_sanctuary.des: The Pocket opens 2 seconds after a blow instead of 5.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_sanctuary.lor: Home doesn't ask whom you are running from.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_hearth.name: Hearth
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_hearth.desc: In your own Pocket you don't get hungry.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_garden.name: Garden in the Void
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_garden.desc: While you are home, crops, saplings and other growing things within 4 blocks of you grow about twice as fast.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_garden.lore: Even in the void something takes root.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_two_doors.des: The Pocket remembers where you entered it the time before. Leaving with Shift (Shift+H) takes you there instead of where you came from now, even to another world. Guests go back to their own places.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_two_doors.lor: Every house has a back door.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_shelter.name: Saving Rift
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_shelter.desc: When a blow leaves you at 3 hearts or less, the Pocket takes you (and whoever stands by) home at once. Costs 20 Void; at most once every 15 minutes; not with a boss within 48 blocks, not on an arena, not without the Void for it. A killing blow still kills.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_shelter.lore: The void doesn't give up its own.
mages_legacy.talent.void_eyes.name: Eyes of the Void
mages_legacy.talent.void_eyes.desc: In the dark (light 7 or less) you have Night Vision.
mages_legacy.talent.void_eyes.lore: Darkness is the colour of home.
mages_legacy.talent.step_soft.name: Weightless
mages_legacy.talent.step_soft.desc: After a step, 3 seconds of Slow Falling: step off a cliff or into the air and come down gently.
mages_legacy.talent.step_sense.name: Sense of the Void
mages_legacy.talent.step_sense.desc: Coming out of the void, you see every enemy within 12 blocks through walls for 4 seconds (glowing).
mages_legacy.talent.step_echo.name: Echo of the Step
mages_legacy.talent.step_echo.desc: For 3 seconds after a step the step key takes you back to where you stepped from — free, without restarting the cooldown.
mages_legacy.talent.step_echo.lore: The void remembers where you came from.
mages_legacy.talent.step_ambush.name: Shadow of the Void
mages_legacy.talent.step_ambush.desc: For 5 seconds after a step, creatures notice you only from half their usual distance.
mages_legacy.talent.step_stone.name: Stone Path
mages_legacy.talent.step_stone.desc: A step that went through blocks, not just air, gives back 8 Void.
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_cleanse.name: Soft Landing
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_cleanse.desc: Whoever comes out of your passage floats down gently (Slow Falling) and can't be knocked back for 3 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.grav_anchor.name: Footing
mages_legacy.talent.grav_anchor.desc: While Heavier Gravity holds, nothing knocks you back.
mages_legacy.talent.grav_drain.name: The Weight Feeds
mages_legacy.talent.grav_drain.desc: Every pulse of weight gives back 1 Void for each enemy held (up to 3 a pulse).
mages_legacy.talent.grav_fuse.name: Heavy Fuse
mages_legacy.talent.grav_fuse.desc: Creepers under Heavier Gravity can't explode (unless set alight).
mages_legacy.talent.grav_fuse.lore: Even a blast needs room to unfold.
mages_legacy.talent.grav_chain.name: Chains of Space
mages_legacy.talent.grav_chain.desc: Enemies held by the weight can't teleport (endermen, shulkers) and jump half as high. Bosses are unaffected.
mages_legacy.talent.grav_linger.name: Lingering Weight
mages_legacy.talent.grav_linger.desc: When Heavier Gravity ends, its field stays in place 3 more seconds and slows enemies (no damage).
mages_legacy.talent.grav_feast.name: Growing Weight
mages_legacy.talent.grav_feast.desc: Every enemy that dies under Heavier Gravity holds it 1 second longer (3 seconds at most per cast).
mages_legacy.talent.hole_sated.name: A Sated Abyss
mages_legacy.talent.hole_sated.desc: If the collapse strikes 3 enemies or more, you get 20 Void back. The recoil stays.
mages_legacy.talent.step_homeward.name: The Way Home
mages_legacy.talent.step_homeward.desc: Rift of Space + Through Worlds. Back from the Pocket, you can Void Step at once: its cooldown is reset.
mages_legacy.talent.step_rupture.name: Rupture
mages_legacy.talent.step_rupture.desc: Through Worlds + Gravity. Enemies you pass through during a step are shoved aside off your path and slowed for a second. No damage; bosses aren't shoved.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_hold.name: Heavy Threshold
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_hold.desc: Rift of Space + Gravity. While Heavier Gravity holds, the Pocket opens even right after a blow.
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_charge_2.name: Second Ripple
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_charge_2.desc: Through Worlds gains a second charge. Charges recover independently.
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_charge_3.name: Third Ripple
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_charge_3.desc: Through Worlds gains a third charge.
mages_legacy.talent.worlds_charge_3.lore: The finer the hearing, the more the roads.
mages_legacy.passage.title: Through Worlds
mages_legacy.passage.hint: Whom to open the way to?
mages_legacy.message.passage_to_you: %s opened a passage to you from the void: the rift before you, %s s.
mages_legacy.refuse.no_one: Nobody else is on the server
mages_legacy.refuse.passage_there: No passage opens there: that player is in a closed world
mages_legacy.talent.step_ambush.lore: Who steps out of the void stays in it a little longer.
mages_legacy.refuse.protected: This place is protected: the void doesn't lead there
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.perk.1: Spores: the race's resource, gathering by themselves (1 a second)
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.perk.2: Mycelium Network: living travel nodes for the whole server
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.perk.3: Neurospores weaken and confuse enemies, Neurosymbiosis quickens allies
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.perk.4: Fungal food can do more through the diet in the tree
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.weak.1: Fire and lava hurt half as much again
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.weak.2: Under the open day sun Spores don't gather
mages_legacy.xp.mycelid.1: Grow a node of the network
mages_legacy.xp.mycelid.2: Someone else travelling through your network
mages_legacy.ability.mycelium_network.de: H: at an own node, its settings and routes; elsewhere, the colony: nutrients, your nodes and "Grow a node here". A node grows on solid ground; the first is the Mother Mycelium (free), the next cost 20 nutrients, 4 nodes in all. Your nodes closer than 128 blocks join by themselves; far ones (up to 2000 blocks, one world) need a grown thread: 1 nutrient per 20 blocks and a second of growth per 25 blocks. Any player may use the network: a click on a node shows where it leads. Feed it by clicking a node with mushrooms, fungi, bone meal, flesh or any food (Shift: the whole stack).
mages_legacy.ability.mycelium_network.lo: Wherever you walk, the mycelium is there already.
mages_legacy.ability.neurospores.name: Neurospores
mages_legacy.ability.neurospores.desc: R: a cloud of neuroactive spores, radius 5, for 6 seconds where you stand. Infected enemies get Weakness I and Slowness I, and each second have a 25% chance to lose their target and stumble; the infection lasts 3 more seconds after leaving the cloud. Bosses only feel the Weakness. No damage. 25 Spores, 20-second cooldown.
mages_legacy.ability.neurospores.lore: No need to kill. It's enough that the enemy forgets why it came.
mages_legacy.ability.neurosymbiosis.name: Neurosymbiosis
mages_legacy.ability.neurosymbiosis.desc: V: you, the players within 6 blocks and your pets share symbiotic spores for 8 seconds: +10% movement speed, +5% attack speed, slowness removed. 30 Spores, 35-second cooldown.
mages_legacy.ability.neurosymbiosis.lore: One mycelium, one thought for all.
mages_legacy.ability.great_bloom.name: Great Bloom
mages_legacy.ability.spore_storm.name: Spore Storm
mages_legacy.talent.state.awakening_late: This Awakening comes in the next part of the race
mages_legacy.talent.mycelium_network.des: The Mycelid's core: a living travel network for the whole server. The whole tree grows from here.
mages_legacy.talent.neurospores.name: Neurospores
mages_legacy.talent.neurospores.desc: The basic ability of Neurospores (key R).
mages_legacy.talent.neurosymbiosis.name: Neurosymbiosis
mages_legacy.talent.neurosymbiosis.desc: The basic ability of Symbiosis (key V).
mages_legacy.talent.net_nodes_1.name: Spreading I
mages_legacy.talent.net_nodes_1.desc: The colony holds 6 nodes instead of 4.
mages_legacy.talent.net_nodes_2.name: Spreading II
mages_legacy.talent.net_nodes_3.name: Spreading III
mages_legacy.talent.net_thrift.name: Thrifty Colony
mages_legacy.talent.net_thrift.desc: Nodes and threads cost 40% fewer nutrients.
mages_legacy.talent.net_reach.name: Far Threads
mages_legacy.talent.net_reach.desc: Your nodes join by themselves within 256 blocks, and grown threads reach up to 4000 blocks.
mages_legacy.talent.net_train.name: Living Caravan
mages_legacy.talent.net_train.desc: Travelling through your nodes, players take their pets and leashed animals within 6 blocks along.
mages_legacy.talent.net_growth.name: Quick Growth
mages_legacy.talent.net_swift.name: Swift Threads
mages_legacy.talent.net_swift.desc: Journeys through your nodes are 40% shorter.
mages_legacy.talent.net_toll.name: Gift of Travellers
mages_legacy.talent.net_toll.desc: Every journey of another player through your node brings 2 nutrients.
mages_legacy.talent.net_sense.name: Watchful Mycelium
mages_legacy.talent.net_sense.desc: While you are online, monsters within 8 blocks of your nodes glow.
mages_legacy.talent.net_recall.name: Call of the Colony
mages_legacy.talent.net_recall.desc: Shift + the network key takes you through the mycelium to your Mother Mycelium from anywhere (even another world). Once every 10 minutes; not from a Pocket or an arena.
mages_legacy.talent.net_shared.name: Shared Mycelium
mages_legacy.talent.net_shared.desc: Your open nodes join by themselves with other Mycelids' open nodes nearby: the server's network grows together.
mages_legacy.talent.net_glow.name: Glowing Paths
mages_legacy.talent.net_glow.desc: Whoever arrives through your nodes gets 4 food.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_bloom.name: Awakening: Great Bloom
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_bloom.desc: You root into the ground as a huge glowing mushroom for 15 seconds: allies (players and your pets) within 50 blocks get Regeneration I. The mushroom can't move or strike and can be hurt and killed; the view steps outside meanwhile. Pressed again, the Bloom ends early. Then 10 seconds of exhaustion. 60 Spores, 5-minute cooldown from its end.
mages_legacy.talent.bloom_heal.name: Abundant Spores
mages_legacy.talent.bloom_heal.desc: The Great Bloom gives Regeneration II instead of I.
mages_legacy.talent.bloom_bark.name: Woody Bark
mages_legacy.talent.bloom_bark.desc: The mushroom form takes 25% less damage.
mages_legacy.talent.bloom_roots.name: Roots of the Colony
mages_legacy.talent.bloom_roots.desc: If the mushroom grew within 32 blocks of your node, the healing reaches 75 blocks.
mages_legacy.talent.bloom_long.name: Long Bloom
mages_legacy.talent.bloom_long.desc: The Great Bloom lasts 22 seconds instead of 15.
mages_legacy.talent.spore_wide.name: Wide Cloud
mages_legacy.talent.spore_wide.desc: Neurospores' radius is 7 blocks instead of 5.
mages_legacy.talent.spore_wide_2.name: Spore Fog
mages_legacy.talent.spore_quick.name: Frequent Release
mages_legacy.talent.spore_quick.desc: Neurospores recover in 14 seconds instead of 20.
mages_legacy.talent.spore_long.name: Lasting Cloud
mages_legacy.talent.spore_long.desc: The Neurospore cloud lasts 9 seconds instead of 6.
mages_legacy.talent.spore_spread.name: Contagion
mages_legacy.talent.spore_spread.desc: An enemy first infected by the cloud passes the spores to enemies within 3 blocks of it.
mages_legacy.talent.spore_confuse.name: Broken Coordination
mages_legacy.talent.spore_confuse.desc: The infected lose their target and stumble with a 45% chance instead of 25%.
mages_legacy.talent.spore_mark.name: Marked
mages_legacy.talent.spore_trail.name: Spore Trail
mages_legacy.talent.spore_trail.desc: The Neurospore cloud follows you instead of staying put.
mages_legacy.talent.spore_feeble.name: Tremor
mages_legacy.talent.spore_feeble.desc: The infected get Weakness II instead of I (bosses still I).
mages_legacy.talent.spore_linger.name: Smouldering Spores
mages_legacy.talent.spore_linger.desc: The infection lasts 8 seconds after leaving the cloud instead of 3.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_storm.name: Awakening: Spore Storm
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_storm.desc: You release every stored spore (at least 50): for 10 seconds a storm of radius 18 whirls around you. Enemies are infected, get Weakness II and Slowness II and often lose their target; bosses only Weakness I. Allies (players and pets) get Speed I and Haste I, and slowness is lifted from them. Then 15 seconds of exhaustion. 5-minute cooldown.
mages_legacy.talent.storm_long.name: Lingering Storm
mages_legacy.talent.storm_long.desc: The Spore Storm lasts 14 seconds instead of 10.
mages_legacy.talent.storm_wide.name: Wide Storm
mages_legacy.talent.storm_wide.desc: The Spore Storm's radius is 24 blocks instead of 18.
mages_legacy.talent.storm_keep.name: Spore Reserve
mages_legacy.talent.storm_keep.desc: A quarter of your spores remain after the Spore Storm.
mages_legacy.talent.storm_ally.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
mages_legacy.talent.storm_ally.desc: Allies in the storm also get Resistance I.
mages_legacy.talent.storm_blind.name: Blinding Storm
mages_legacy.talent.storm_blind.desc: Every 3 seconds the storm blinds enemies for a moment (not bosses).
mages_legacy.talent.sym_pulse.name: Shared Impulse
mages_legacy.talent.sym_pulse.desc: Neurosymbiosis gives +15% speed instead of +10%, and Jump Boost I.
mages_legacy.talent.sym_reflex.name: Protective Reflex
mages_legacy.talent.sym_reflex.desc: The first blow on each one sharing the symbiosis deals 40% less damage.
mages_legacy.talent.sym_unity.name: One Organism
mages_legacy.talent.sym_unity.desc: Neurosymbiosis reaches 10 blocks and lasts 12 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.sym_adapt.name: Spore Adaptation
mages_legacy.talent.sym_adapt.desc: While the symbiosis lasts, nothing slows those sharing it.
mages_legacy.talent.sym_share.name: Shared Recovery
mages_legacy.talent.sym_share.desc: When the symbiosis ends, everyone sharing it recovers 4 health.
mages_legacy.talent.diet_1.name: Fungal Exchange
mages_legacy.talent.diet_1.desc: Fungal food (mushroom, suspicious and rabbit stew) gives 3 more food.
mages_legacy.talent.sym_env.name: Dense Shell
mages_legacy.talent.sym_env.desc: Fire hurts only 20% more, and under the sun Spores gather at half speed instead of not at all.
mages_legacy.talent.diet_2.name: Deep Symbiosis
mages_legacy.talent.sym_night.name: Night Growth
mages_legacy.talent.sym_night.desc: At night and underground Spores gather half again as fast.
mages_legacy.talent.diet_3.name: Perfect Metabolism
mages_legacy.talent.diet_3.desc: Fungal food gives the colony 8 nutrients.
mages_legacy.talent.sym_aura.name: Living Aura
mages_legacy.talent.sym_aura.desc: While your symbiosis lasts, allies coming near you join it.
mages_legacy.talent.awakening_rebirth.de: The Awakening's key by an own node (within 6 blocks) starts growing a reserve body there: 40 nutrients, 3 minutes; pressed again it tells how it is. One body only. A killing blow wakes it: you appear by that node (even in another world) with 30% health, fire, poison and wither cleared, then 30 seconds of exhaustion. The 20-minute cooldown runs from the moment a body starts growing. Without a grown body death is death; spores and other Awakenings' cooldowns are not restored.
mages_legacy.talent.rebirth_fast.name: Quick Body
mages_legacy.talent.rebirth_fast.desc: The reserve body grows in a minute and a half instead of three.
mages_legacy.talent.rebirth_health.name: Hardy Body
mages_legacy.talent.rebirth_health.desc: You have 50% health after rebirth instead of 30%.
mages_legacy.talent.rebirth_cheap.name: Modest Body
mages_legacy.talent.rebirth_cheap.desc: The reserve body costs 20 nutrients instead of 40.
mages_legacy.talent.rebirth_soft.name: Gentle Waking
mages_legacy.talent.rebirth_soft.desc: The exhaustion after rebirth lasts 15 seconds instead of 30.
mages_legacy.talent.spore_nodes.name: Spore Nodes
mages_legacy.talent.spore_nodes.desc: Colony + Neurospores. While you are online, your nodes give Weakness I to monsters within 6 blocks every 2 seconds (not bosses).
mages_legacy.talent.spore_feed.name: Feeding on the Infected
mages_legacy.talent.spore_feed.desc: Neurospores + Symbiosis. Every infected enemy gives you 1 Spore a second back (up to 4 a second).
mages_legacy.talent.heal_nodes.name: Healing Nodes
mages_legacy.talent.heal_nodes.desc: Colony + Symbiosis. While you are online, players within 8 blocks of your nodes get Regeneration I.
mages_legacy.talent.spore_travel.name: Spore Wake
mages_legacy.talent.spore_travel.desc: Colony + Neurospores. Arriving through the network, you come out in a cloud of neurospores (4 blocks, 4 seconds).
mages_legacy.talent.sym_spores.name: Symbiotic Spores
mages_legacy.talent.sym_spores.desc: Neurospores + Symbiosis. Blows of those sharing your symbiosis infect enemies for 4 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.node_food.name: Fungal Larders
mages_legacy.talent.node_food.desc: Colony + Symbiosis. While you are online, players within 6 blocks of your nodes are slowly fed.
